analysis.title: USA: Where is the Crowd Positioned Ahead of Results? Stock insights for HF and LO
key_insights: Hedge funds are net long and crowded into US names reporting this week, with a crowding score of +5.6 versus +1.3 for the broader region.
Heavily short hedge-fund-crowded names reporting this week (score below -14): DTM, NEXT, RIVN, SFM, SOFI, WSO.
Heavily long hedge-fund-crowded names reporting this week (score above +21): BMY, CVX, FCX, GD, GILD, ICE, JCI, KLAC, PSX, STX.

Positioning tailwind list: hedge fund crowded longs where mutual funds are underweight include AMZN, BAC, BRK/B, CRWD, CVX, DOW, ET, FTNT, GD, META, MMM, MO, MPC, MSFT, NEM, ORCL, OXY, PFE, PG, PSX, PYPL and TSLA.
COST, NBR and RTX are no longer among the top 3 hedge fund crowded longs and mutual fund underweights.
earnings_insights: Hedge funds are long crowded into names reporting this week, with a crowding score of +5.6 versus +1.3 for the broader region. Heavily short crowded reporters: DTM, NEXT, RIVN, SFM, SOFI, WSO. Heavily long crowded reporters: BMY, CVX, FCX, GD, GILD, ICE, JCI, KLAC, PSX, STX.
risk_factors: Crowded long positioning in names reporting this week raises the risk of sharp moves if results disappoint.
Heavily short crowded names (RIVN, SOFI and others) carry squeeze risk on a positive result.
